summary: DJR's page for Megazoid, a blocky 1970s sci-fi display face with variable shade layers (DPTH, STRK axes on Left/Right Shade styles). A run of saturated full-width colour bands (rainbow stripes, synthwave grid, Atari game-manual copy) alternates word stacks and layered-shade compositions with a designer essay, a styles list with depth/stroke sliders, a working calculator, a stylistic-set card index, a glyph grid and DJR's standard on-page licence cart.

instances.ux: Stripes draw in first, then the name appears and its shade depth animates in; DJR's slim site nav sits above
instances.learn: Build the shade from two stacked layers per letter (fill + variable shade font) so the 3D depth can be animated with an axis instead of an image
